legend: A dragon symbolizes wisdom, power and wealth. On Lunar New Year's Day, people model a dragon with bamboo strips and clothes, raise them with rods, and hold the rods high and low to resemble a flying dragon.
A performer holding the rod low is represented by a 1, while one holding it high is represented by a 2. Thus, the line of performers can be represented by a sequence a1, a2, ..., an.

Little Tommy is among them. He would like to choose an interval [l, r] (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n), then reverse al, al + 1, ..., ar so that the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the new sequence is maximum.
A non-decreasing subsequence is a sequence of indices p1, p2, ..., pk, such that p1 < p2 < ... < pk and ap1 ≤ ap2 ≤ ... ≤ apk. The length of the subsequence is k.
input: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000), denoting the length of the original sequence.
The second line contains n space-separated integers, describing the original sequence a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 2, i = 1, 2, ..., n).
output: Print a single integer, which means the maximum possible length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence of the new sequence.
note: In the first example, after reversing [2, 3], the array will become [1, 1, 2, 2], where the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence is 4.
In the second example, after reversing [3, 7], the array will become [1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1], where the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence is 9.

legend.ai: 龙象征着智慧、力量和财富。在农历新年这一天，人们用竹条和布料制作龙身，用杆子将其撑起，并将杆子举高或放低，使其看起来像一条飞舞的龙。
将杆子举低的表演者用 1 表示，而将杆子举高的表演者用 2 表示。因此，表演者队列可以表示为一个序列 a1, a2, ..., an。
小 Tommy 也在其中。他想选择一个区间 [l, r]（1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n），然后翻转 al, al + 1, ..., ar，使新序列的最长非递减子序列长度最大。
非递减子序列是一个下标序列 p1、p2、...、pk，满足 p1 < p2 < ... < pk 且 ap1 ≤ ap2 ≤ ... ≤ apk。子序列的长度为 k。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 2000），表示原序列的长度。
第二行包含 n 个以空格分隔的整数，表示原序列 a1、a2、...、an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 2，i = 1，2，...，n）。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示新序列的最长非递减子序列的可能最大长度。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，翻转 [2， 3] 后，数组将变为 [1， 1， 2， 2]，其中最长非递减子序列的长度为 4。
在第二个样例中，翻转 [3， 7] 后，数组将变为 [1， 1， 1， 1， 2， 2， 2， 2， 2， 1]，其中最长非递减子序列的长度为 9。
